script_text: Stop, Taurus, the cosmos has just pulled a dangerously volatile and unpredictable card from your deck today. Mars is forming a harsh square to your ruling planet, Venus, shifting intense friction into your 7th House of Partnerships. This transit demands you confront hidden tensions with a significant other before they explode into bitter arguments. If you are taken, a sudden clash over shared finances will test your patience today. Singles must resist the urge to chase someone who is already committed to another. In your 10th House of Career, a lucrative professional offer may demand a compromise of your core values, which the Earth element within you will refuse to accept. Avoid making any sudden emotional decisions today, as the stars are actually gifting you unexpected clarity instead. Follow for tomorrow's reading to see exactly how this intense transit resolves.
